bigquery.applicationStatus: not present in active application code or cloud resource receipts searched; this is an optional future analytics warehouse, not a deployed KAIRO service
bigquery.location: Johannesburg africa-south1 is an available BigQuery location; job/dataset location must be explicit and colocated resources matter
bigquery.pricing: Official pricing reviewed: on-demand analysis is USD $6.25/TiB in Johannesburg-region pricing group after the first 1 TiB/month free per billing account; storage, ingestion, ML and transfer have separate charges. Re-check live pricing before any future use.
bigquery.ml: BigQuery ML built-in training and imported models are listed in the Johannesburg support matrix. DNN/AutoML/hyperparameter training and remote model endpoints have separate support/location rules; a global model endpoint does not guarantee a processing location.
bigquery.quotasAndControls: Current docs list 200 TiB/day default on-demand query usage per project and no default per-user daily limit. Apply tighter project/user custom quotas, dry-run query estimates, and configuration.query.maximumBytesBilled on each on-demand job. The latter fails a query before execution when its estimated billed bytes exceed the cap; it is not a whole-billing-account spend cap.
bigquery.fit: Only reconsider for consented, de-identified, event-level aggregate analysis after a measured need. Do not send source documents, CVs, audio or free-text answers to an analytics warehouse.

currentStoreRoles.firestore: Operational records: the hosted pilot has a real Firestore Native Standard database in africa-south1 and an owner-scoped repository contract for source/lesson/job/progress record types. The public hosted handoff says source/lesson migration and the complete learner UI are still unfinished; do not claim all learner records already use it.
currentStoreRoles.cloudStorage: File/object layer: the mounted, consent-gated adapter copies only reviewed source text with source ID/revision, bounded to 100 reviewed pages, 48,000 characters and 220 KiB; it does not copy the original upload. Private-bucket location/configuration is described in hosted evidence; recheck before any residency claim.
currentStoreRoles.retrieval: Source retrieval is exact-offset lexical matching in a local library. It is not BigQuery, not an embedding/vector index, and not a hosted multi-tenant RAG service.
currentStoreRoles.bigquery: Optional future analytics over minimized events; not the OLTP/source store, binary store, or retrieval index. It offers SQL scans/aggregations but adds ingestion, query/storage/egress cost, region alignment and a separate deletion/governance path.

proposedLearningEvents.status: proposal only; not implemented or consented
proposedLearningEvents.purpose: Evaluate transparent next-step rules and aggregate learning-task completion, not to build permanent ability profiles or optimize engagement.
proposedLearningEvents.consent: Separate optional analytics consent, stated purpose, retention window and withdrawal/deletion path; core reading/practice remains available when declined.
minimumFields: event_type (source_reviewed, practice_attempted, hint_requested, task_completed, resumed, reading_selected)
exclude: inferred disability, emotion, ability, motivation or demographic traits
proposedLearningEvents.retentionAndAccess: Proposed short 30-day event-level retention for an opt-in pilot, then delete or retain only coarse aggregate counts; keep identity mapping outside the analytics dataset; scope event access to the evaluation owner and provide correction/deletion route.
proposedLearningEvents.evaluation: Report the event count and missingness; compare a transparent rule baseline against a held-out-by-learner evaluation only when consented, sufficient independent data exists. Until then report behavior/check completion, never forecast, mastery, learning gain or traction.

judging.Product: Supports source-to-practice evidence only when chosen source rights and revisions are known; current whole journey still needs root integration/acceptance.
judging.Intelligence: Enables a measurable, transparent rule baseline; no trained learner model or validated forecast is present.
judging.Sustainability: Avoids paying to process a data warehouse before event volume justifies it; compare measured per-session analytics and query costs before adoption.
judging.Impact: Keeps privacy and accessibility in the evidence path; no learning gains or learner outcomes are inferred from public datasets.

remainingGaps: No item-level reuse and cross-asset rights clearance has been performed for a KAIRO source pack.
